open_points.subject: R0-10 and A6/A30 Registry configuration lifecycle
open_points.text: State 0 R0-10 says environment configuration is validated when the service starts: “The service is configured only by environment variables, which it validates when it starts.” State 2 A6/A30 instead says `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` “is read by the Registry gateway at each call, not at start-up,” “is no required start-up variable,” and may be absent until a Registry call fails as `transport_error`.
open_points.question: Must a missing or unusable `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` prevent service startup, or may the service start and defer the failure until a Registry operation is attempted?
options: Validate `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` at startup and refuse to start when it is missing or unusable.
Allow startup without `REGISTRY_BASE_URL`; each Registry call reads it and fails as `transport_error` when it is missing or unusable.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the more specific State 2 rule: allow startup and fail Registry calls as `transport_error`.

witness.initial: All startup environment settings are valid, but `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` is absent.
events: The deployment operator starts the portal service.
A caller requests liveness or readiness.
An authenticated caller later invokes a project operation requiring Registry validation.
outcomes: Under R0-10, startup is refused during environment validation, so no health or project request can be served.
Under A6/A30, startup and public health checks succeed; only the later project operation fails with a Registry `transport_error`.
witness.observer: The deployment operator and callers of the health and project endpoints.
